rounds.story: Lafika ngeAfrikansi ethi aartappel. Namhlanje ligama eliqhelekileyo lokubiza le mifuno etyiwayo phantse kuzo zonke izindlu.
Lisuka kwigama leAfrikansi elithi baadjie. Xa kubanda, wonke umntu uyazi ukuba ibhatyi yeyokugquma umzimba.
Lisondele kakhulu kwelaseDatshi neAfrikansi elithi winkel. Yindawo apho sithenga khona izinto zemihla ngemihla.
Livela kwelaseAfrikansi elithi straat. Sisona gama siqhelekileyo xa sithetha indlela ephakathi kwezindlu nezakhiwo.
Lafika ngeAfrikansi ethi tafel. Itafile yindawo yokubeka ukutya, iincwadi okanye yokuhlala kubhalwa.
Lisuka kwelaseAfrikansi elithi suiker. Xa kusenziwa iti okanye ikofu, abantu abaninzi bayayifaka iswekile.
Leli gama lafika kunye nomdlalo wokulwa waseJapan. Ijudo igxile kubuchule bokusebenzisa intshukumo kunamandla nje.
Ikarati ligama elaziwa ngezemidlalo zokuzikhusela elivela eJapan. Lidla ngokudityaniswa neentshukumo ezikhawulezayo.
Leli gama laziwa ngokutya kwaseJapan okudla ngokudibanisa irayisi nezinye izithako. Ngoku lifumaneka nakwiivenkile ezininzi.
Igama lisuka eTaliyane. Ipitsa sisonka esicaba esibhakwa sinezongezo ngaphezulu, kwaye sithandwa ngabantu abaninzi.
Livela kulwimi lwaseTurkey. Iyogathi kukutya kobisi obuvundisiweyo, kudliwa njengeshwamshwam okanye nesidlo sakusasa.
Leli gama lisuka kwisiSwahili, apho lithetha uhambo. Apha lisetyenziswa xa kuthethwa utyelelo okanye uhambo lokujonga izinto.
